hero.caption: St. Vincent Island at the westernmost end of Apalachicola Bay, Franklin County, Florida. latitude 29° 39” 16.83’, longitude -85° 7” 50.20’. Shows the strandplain with well-developed beach ridges that comprises St. Vincent Island. Another narrow strandplain is present along southern edge of mainland. Created from USDA/FSA Aerial Photography Field Office 2010 NAIP digital aerial orthophoto mosaic for Gulf and Franklin counties, Florida, using global Mapper 12.0.
